name: Clean House
overview: The topic of "Clean House" in Scripture emphasizes both spiritual purity and wise stewardship of the home. The Psalmist pleads for cleansing and renewal of a pure heart, highlighting the necessity of God’s transformative work within us. Proverbs underscores the importance of wisdom and diligence in building and maintaining a household, contrasting the wise woman who builds her house with the foolish who destroy it through neglect. Matthew’s teaching on the unclean spirit reminds believers of the ongoing need to guard against spiritual emptiness after deliverance, reinforcing that true cleanliness involves continual vigilance and renewal.
